title: Potion of Invisibility
summary: Grants 10 turns of Invisibility when drunk or splashed.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action on yourself. Invisible for 10 turns.
fields.Throw: Action, 60 ft range. Applies Invisible for 10 turns to creatures within a 3 ft radius.
fields.Invisible: Advantage on attack rolls. Incoming attacks have disadvantage. Attacking, casting, taking an action or bonus action, interacting with an object, taking damage, or becoming Wet ends it. Inspecting a chest normally preserves it, but moving the contents does not.
fields.Crafting: Ashes of Imp Patagium plus any Essence.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
